description: This file defines the WorkoutCardPresenter class, a custom presenter used for displaying workout cards with styled backgrounds and images within an Android TV application. It manages creating view holders, binding workout data to UI elements, and unbinding views.

classes.name: WorkoutCardPresenter
classes.description: A presenter class for rendering workout cards with customized visuals in an Android TV UI.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and configures a new ImageCardView wrapped in a ViewHolder, setting dimensions, focusability, and background style.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a Workout object to the ImageCardView, populating the title, content text, and loading thumbnail images with Glide.

methods.name: onUnbindViewHolder
methods.description: Clears the image from the card view when unbinding.
